sentences.text: Researchers conducted a retrospective review of medical records from a major cancer center and children's hospital, covering the period from 2012 to 2025, to examine a group of children treated for tumors inside the spinal cord.
In this specific cohort, every tumor was located in the neck region of the spinal cord.
The authors concluded that treating the condition before severe symptoms appear might lead to better long-term nerve function.
